edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the investing address and referral source in doInvest
msg.sender is used to load the investor record in getMyDividends
msg.sender is checked in the onlyAdmin(Full) modifier of provideAccess
msg.sender is checked in onlyAdmin for setAdminAddr
msg.sender is checked in onlyAdmin for setPayerAddr
block.timestamp determines daysAfter and payment gating in getMyDividends
block.timestamp gates the 12 hours wait in payout
notOnPause compares waveStartup and now in doInvest
nextWave writes waveStartup = now
m_investors state is read and updated while paying dividends
m_investors is written with new values and referral bonuses in doInvest
m_investors is iterated during push payout
m_paysys.latestTime and mode gate getMyDividends
m_paysys.latestKeyIndex drives the payout loop
m_referrals check and write controls referral bonus logic in doInvest
m_dividendsPercent multiplies investor value in getMyDividends
m_adminPercent computes the admin commission transfer
m_payerPercent computes the payer commission transfer
m_refPercent computes the referral reward
adminAddr is the receiver of the external transfer
payerAddr is the receiver of the external transfer
doInvest performs adminAddr.transfer commission
doInvest performs payerAddr.transfer commission
doInvest adds the percent bonus to the deposit value, a percent arithmetic computation
getMyDividends computes daysAfter with sub/div over now
getMyDividends multiplies percent by investor value and daysAfter
Fallback calls getMyDividends when msg.value is zero
Fallback calls doInvest when msg.value is non-zero
getMyDividends calls nextWave when the contract balance is insufficient
getMyDividends calls sendDividends when no ref bonus exists
getMyDividends calls sendDividendsWithRefBonus when ref bonus exists

payout calls sendDividendsWithRefBonus when ref bonus exists

normalization_plan.reason: Input parameter addr of insert is only used to key the state_var s within insert
Input parameter value of insert only feeds the write to s.data[addr].value inside insert
refs array parameter exists only to resolve referral addresses within doInvest
mode parameter is only used to change m_paysys.mode called from setPullPaymode
rank parameter is only consumed by the access write in provideAccess
Loop counter i is a transient index confined to the payout loop
addr parameter is only assigned into the adminAddr state variable in setAdminAddr
Local investor struct is a temporary copy consumed only by getMyDividends
daysAfter local is an intermediate value inside getMyDividends
reward local is an intermediate referral bonus value inside doInvest
keyIndex local is a transient cursor used only inside insert
size local is a transient bound for the payout iteration
